findings.text: The company was incorporated on 22 June 2004 and is recorded as active.
The status detail records an active proposal to strike off.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last accounts made up to 31 December 2024 and the next due 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the last made up to 26 June 2026 and the next due 10 July 2027.
There are 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 555 (appointed 28 April 2026) and PERSON 556 (appointed 16 October 2023), and 1 other officer.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2111, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
Six of the 50 other companies listed for the two current directors are dissolved, and the list is based on officer ID matching, so it may be incomplete.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 555 was appointed as a director on 28 April 2026 and PERSON 563 resigned as a director on 26 May 2026.
